role: Sole machine-readable authority for the live Elpis system boundary. Every other description (README, docs, build files) is derived from or checked against this file.
purpose: Research direction: geodesic intelligence. Persistent structured state, memory topology, relational structure, bounded transformations, controlled evolution and inference interact so that computation follows structure already accumulated by the system instead of being reconstructed from an unstructured prompt. This is an architectural research direction, not a claim of general intelligence.

shared_modules.role: Canonical content identity v1 (domain-framed canonical JSON SHA-256) used across subsystems.

subsystems.purpose: Machine/OS substrate and memory management below every model: content hashing, FMS residency (HOT/WARM/COLD logical tiers over RAM/device/storage physical domains) with a POSIX platform abstraction layer, Linux descriptor capabilities, sealed native loading, deployment-pinned resource authority and verified file-backed assets materialized on demand into bounded residency.
subsystems.mutation_authority: The substrate never mutates admitted external assets (no writable replicas). It owns only its own residency state: page registration, leases and eviction inside configured budgets. Admission requires a deployment-pinned catalog; inspection never creates authority.
subsystems.runtime_participation: Constructed by the runtime composition when file-backed memory is configured; consumed by inference (associative rows, experts, prefetch).
subsystems.security_boundary: Trusted root selected once; opens resolve beneath its descriptor with openat2 RESOLVE_BENEATH|RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS; native code is copied into a sealed memfd, digest-verified, then loaded. Linux only; other platforms fail closed.
subsystems.maturity: Mechanics qualified: native FMS invariant/concurrency/adversarial suites, Python admission/lease/eviction/adversarial path suites.
incomplete_interfaces: COLD tier for file assets is external immutable storage only; no writable cold replica is implemented.
Buffered pread accounting does not charge or bound the Linux page cache.
No accelerator/device fences on the CPU POSIX PAL (bind_fence fails closed).

subsystems.purpose: Persistent identity, continuity and history: deterministic entities and lifecycle, sender-bound local messaging, deterministic scheduling, one authoritative durable event history, canonical state roots, replay, checkpoints, crash recovery, read-only topology and context projections, and the frozen Structural R0 mutation grammar.
subsystems.mutation_authority: Only Kernel transitions (found/activate/dormant/terminate/message/step) mutate ECS state, each linearized under the kernel lock and committed as one framed event before the projection is installed. Projections (topology, context) are read-only. Entity-facing code sends only through kernel-bound EntityPort objects and cannot choose its sender.
subsystems.runtime_participation: The runtime composition owns one Kernel as the system's durable history; receipts of other subsystems are recorded there as messages. Projections feed inference context read-only.
subsystems.persistence: Length-framed append-only event log with fsync durability boundary and complete-frame crash recovery; checkpoints are rollback-floor markers only.
subsystems.maturity: Mechanics qualified in-process (same-process POSIX model). No cross-process transport or authority.
incomplete_interfaces: Structural R0 mutations are executable and verified but not admitted as kernel transitions.
Cross-process transport, federation and cross-process authority are deferred.

subsystems.purpose: Structural memory and representation: HACF content-addressed cascade/graph identity, chunked content-addressed corpus, FMS-resident exact vector index, context graph and deterministic hybrid retrieval; the native semantic core (typed hypergraph, snapshots and query overlays, context-deficit control, retrieval materialization, evidence typing/admission, bounded semantic views, semantic topology IR, Grid81 structural packets, structural observations); the Python retrieval stage producing validated evidence envelopes; the bounded Grid81 representation (D4 structural semantics, typed projection with orbit identity, structural-group evidence/proposals/orderings/conflicts) and the read-only canonical Grid81 reader with its runtime reduction.
subsystems.mutation_authority: Structural memory is written only by its owner (corpus ingestion into a caller-owned state root). Retrieval, validation, views, topology and observations are read-only and grant no semantic truth, execution or admission authority. Canonical Grid81 state is read here but changed only by the pipeline's canonical writer path.
subsystems.runtime_participation: The runtime composition may own a HACF corpus/index; retrieval results become evidence envelopes consumable by the pipeline, the ECS history and inference structural proposals.
protocol_identifiers_retained: elpis.semantic.*.v1/v2 identity domains (including elpis.semantic.r3_bridge.v1, r3_epoch.v1, r3_query_plan.v1 and grid81.sudoku_template.v1)

Grid81 structural identity domains: elpis.d4_pair_payload.v1, elpis.grid81.{source,row,d4_transform_registry,transition_view,expansion_view,quiescence_view,rationale_view,transition_orbit,expansion_orbit,quiescence_orbit,rationale_orbit}.v1, grid81.structural.v1, g4.0a.spec.v1, g4.0b.1.v1, g5.structural-group-evidence.v1, g5.structural-group-proposal.v1, g5.proposal-ordering.v1, g5.structural-conflict-evidence.v1
Record field values source_gate and source_split inside digested structural records
subsystems.maturity: Mechanics qualified: HACF corpus/vector/hybrid suites incl. cross-host golden fixtures, adversarial and concurrency tests; semantic core suites incl. source-boundary scans and fresh-process determinism; Python retrieval and evidence tests over the native bridge.
incomplete_interfaces: The retrieval bridge library is loaded by explicit path but is not yet digest-pinned through elpis.substrate authority.
Native semantic ABI records keep beta stage prefixes (P2..P8) in struct field names; renaming them is deferred to the next native ABI version.
The retrieval bridge builds no context graph; hybrid retrieval through it is lexical + dense only.
Three D4 conventions coexist (structural semantics, typed projection, structural groups); each is bound into persisted orbit identities, so they are proven set-equivalent by test rather than unified.
Structural-group and typed-projection packages each keep their own canonical-JSON helper; the encodings are digest-bound and are not merged.

subsystems.purpose: The canonical Grid81 writer pipeline, one authority boundary per stage: deterministic structural adjudication -> capability authority decision and one granted-unconsumed structural-influence capability -> capability consumption into an inert artifact -> application against shadow capability state with a durable SQLite application ledger -> read-only advisory promotion plan -> promotion authority (explicit operator approval, one-use capability) -> isolated successor candidate -> atomic publication (durable publication ledger reservation, renameat2 exchange, post-commit verification through the canonical reader).
subsystems.mutation_authority: Only elpis.pipeline.canonical.publisher changes canonical Grid81 state, and only with the exact one-use promotion capability object issued by elpis.pipeline.canonical.authority against an explicit operator approval digest. Adjudication, capability evaluation and promotion planning are read-only; consumption and application write only caller-owned shadow state and ledgers.
subsystems.runtime_participation: The runtime composition may drive the stages in process; nothing runs implicitly, and each stage consumes only the previous stage's typed output.
subsystems.security_boundary: Fail closed at every stage: proposals and model output are never authority; the promotion plan is advisory and non-executable; the one-use promotion capability binds the source canonical digest and generation it was issued against, and the publisher re-reads the canonical root under an exclusive flock on its Canonical parent and refuses any other state, symlinked layout, or candidate inside the root; publication reserves a durable ledger entry, exchanges atomically with renameat2(RENAME_EXCHANGE) and verifies through the production reader; replay is idempotent and a consumed capability cannot be reused. Linux only.
protocol_identifiers_retained: Capability-chain schema identifiers: capability-review-request.v1, capability-authority-{evaluation-input,decision,policy}.v1, capability-{abstention,lifecycle,limit,scope,revocation-policy}.v1, capability-consumption-{policy,receipt,transaction-input,transaction-result}.v1, consumption-rejection-record.v1, application-receipt.v1/v2, promotion-source-chain.v1, g5.1b.v1, g52a-reason-taxonomy.v1, g53a-authority-boundary.v1, g5.structural-influence-capability-nonce.v1
Ledger schemas: elpis.grid81.durable-application-ledger.v2 with elpis.grid81.application-ledger.{entry,genesis}.v2, and the v1 durable ledger used for publication

Promotion phase-evidence identifiers: phase ids G5.3B.1/G5.3C/G5.3D, SourceChain fields g53b1/g53c/g53d, evidence file names and G53*-prefixed rejection codes (all bound into promotion-source-chain digests)
subsystems.maturity: Mechanics qualified: per-stage suites (adjudication, capability authority, consumption, application incl. crash-recovery and cross-process CAS contention, promotion gates and recomputation, promotion authority, candidate construction, publisher protocol incl. concurrent readers, process contention and root aliasing) plus six stage-to-stage integration tests and the full writer chain from a historical canonical fixture.
incomplete_interfaces: Promotion gate evaluation reads the historical phase-evidence directory layout (consumption/application/application-evidence reports); no in-repo stage emits that layout yet, so an end-to-end promotion from live stages can bind application identity in memory but cannot pass the gates without a phase-evidence writer.
Two durable ledger schemas coexist: v1 (publication ledger, required by the publisher) and v2 (artifact-bound application ledger); they are distinct persisted identities and are not merged.
Adjudication consumes structural groups for a caller-pinned row count; there is no streaming or incremental adjudication.
Canonical Grid81 state has one historical fixture generation; no in-repo producer creates a genesis canonical state.

identifier_scan_exemptions.reason: Sealed Structural R0 authority bytes, digest-pinned and byte-identical to the donor; the only match is the phrase 'TRM or learned inference' inside the payload's list of explicitly NOT authorized operations.

nonclaims: Elpis is not claimed to be generally intelligent; 'geodesic intelligence' names a research direction.
No release, tag or PyPI publication exists for this development repository; beta release authority was not migrated.
Mechanics qualification (tests passing) is not scientific qualification and not runtime admission of any learned model.
